title: Aetherlight
description: Aetherlight mod for aetherlighters, adds automatons to fight and aethermeter, is still being worked on.
body: ![This is not from the mod. This is from the game this mod is based on. This mod is not actually accosiated with the aetherlight, it is a fan project.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3be027e6f53997acea6db3ea432d985b447d98f.jpeg)With the aetherlight coming back up, I deciced, why not make a minecraft mod of it? this mod adds the troubleshooter, bombardier, and pacifier. It it very simple right now and is not at all finished, but I will keep working on it until it meets my standards. It also adds some items including the reticulated spline, accelerating apparatus, gyrosphere and aethermeter. the aethermeter I will need to figure out how to make it heal without the player eating it and the other items are for crafting the aethermeter.
